title: alsine tenuifolia subsp. hybrida
intro: Alsine tenuifolia subsp. hybrida, commonly known as Alpine or Rock Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Alsine tenuifolia subsp. hybrida have been found to exhibit antioxidant and hepatoprotective activities, further contributing to its potential medicinal value.
